content: Device code: POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/{common|consumers|organizations}/oauth2/v2.0/devicecode with client_id+scope returns device_code,user_code,verification_uri,expires_in=900,interval=5,message; no verification_uri_complete. Poll POST /oauth2/v2.0/token grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code&client_id&device_code; pending returns HTTP 400 error=authorization_pending (AADSTS70016); bogus device_code returns invalid_grant AADSTS7000014 (not documented bad_verification_code); slow_down per RFC8628 requires +5s interval. refresh_token only if offline_access requested; rotates on every use; 90-day default lifetime.
